text: Kristin Glosimot Kjelsberg, born on 7 November 1959, is a former Norwegian handball player. She played 112 matches and scored 371 goals for the Norwegian national team from 1978 to 1983. In 1984, she represented the club Bækkelagets SK, which won the Norwegian championship that year, and she was the top scorer in the Eliteserien. Kjelsberg also competed at the 1982 World Women's Handball Championship, where the Norwegian team finished in seventh place. She received the Håndballstatuetten trophy from the Norwegian Handball Federation in 1999. This biographical article related to Norwegian team handball is a stub.
